svg.title: EVG — implemented domain class model
svg.desc: Current implemented model, selected fields, and all nineteen canonical relationships with endpoint cardinalities. Four groups distinguish managed authentication and staff authority, catalogue and public aggregate availability, circulation, and owner-only learner records. Planned models are separate. Source SHA-256: 1414bb966b84b5823f7e53638fb0ec0b51aa1798ee082091dc89bf505ff67a20.
svg.text: Current schema · selected fields · cardinalities and privacy boundaries · 2 October 2026

g.title: AuthUser: UUID id, string email, timestamp email_confirmed_at, JSON raw_user_meta_data
ProfileMetadata: string display_name, string preferred_language. JSON fields on auth.users; no public.profiles table. Never a staff-role authority.
StaffMember: UUID user_id, string role, UUID granted_by, timestamp created_at, timestamp updated_at. PK=user_id. Roles=librarian or administrator. No cohort/facilitator role.
AdminBootstrap: string email, string note, timestamp used_at, UUID used_by
Book: UUID id, string title_en, string title_vi, string author, string language, string topic, string description_en, string description_vi, string cover_url
PhysicalCopy: UUID id, UUID book_id, string inventory_code, string condition, string shelf_location
BookAvailability: UUID book_id, int total_copies, int available_copies
Borrower: UUID user_id, string display_name, boolean eligible, UUID registered_by
CirculationPolicy: smallint id, boolean enabled, int max_active_loans, string timezone, UUID updated_by. Singleton id=1; enabled defaults false.

Loan: UUID id, UUID request_id, UUID borrower_user_id, UUID copy_id, date due_date, timestamp checked_out_at, timestamp resolved_at, string resolution, string return_condition, UUID checked_out_by, UUID resolved_by. request_id unique; partial unique index permits one active loan per copy.
g.text: permits one active loan per copy.

g.title: CirculationEvent: UUID id, UUID request_id, UUID loan_id, UUID actor_user_id, string event_type, JSON payload. RPC checkout writes an event. FK alone permits zero events. Append-only to clients; not a general staff-role audit.
g.text: RPC checkout writes an event. FK alone

g.title: ReadingRecord: UUID user_id, UUID book_id, string status, string reflection, timestamp created_at, timestamp updated_at. PK=(user_id,book_id). Owner-only RLS. Reflection at most 2000 characters.
LearnerInterest: UUID user_id, string topic, timestamp created_at. PK=(user_id,topic). Topics=nature,stories,science. Owner-only RLS.

svg.text: role exists in this implemented model.
profile metadata is not a role source.
R-numbers match the local overview links. Cross-group owner, actor, and grant references remain explicit here.
Cardinality: 1 = exactly one · 0..1 = optional one · 0..* = zero or more · — = dependency without cardinality
Composition uses a filled diamond. Dashed arrows are dependencies. A foreign key does not require a child row.
